case.title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement. Need: 20000 pc a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 7 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200004. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70620.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
sup:70620.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You pointed to labour and material costs behind your price, and what matters to a supplier in that position is a firm base to plan on. All three options run for a longer contract term than the one you quoted, which gives you a steadier footing for this part.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longest planning horizon for our business, and it answers the quality point below with a clear commitment from our side.

On quality:
Your quality was 302 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70620@2026Q3).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.52; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.54; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

To help us settle the details, we would also like to understand your calculation better:
Could you send us a cost breakdown for this part?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position. Please note that our internal cost structures are confidential, and we are unable to provide a detailed cost breakdown. Material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our offer is a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

We have reviewed your options and are prepared to agree to a 24-month contract with 45 days payment terms. For this package, we can offer a revised unit price of €4.90. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 45 days net: €4.90 per unit. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €4.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months.

Our offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You told us that your internal cost structure stays confidential, and we respect that. Our options do not depend on a breakdown.

You also accepted one of our arguments, and we are glad of that. We will not repeat the one that was not your reality, and we turn to the terms themselves.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.57; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.62; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.59; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. As this is a decision for the person who signs off on your side, we would be grateful if you would take Option A to them. We hope to settle this together as two family-minded companies who work well with each other.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate the shared values of our family-minded companies and your revised offer. We have reviewed your request internally as suggested, but our pricing structure allows for only a minimal adjustment. 

Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

As an alternative option, for the 24-month contract with 45 days payment terms, we can offer a revised price of €4.89 per unit. This option provides a price of €4.89 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Please note that our offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

warnings: dropped 1 sentence(s): ['A binding two-year term is what we can offer to give your capacity a firm footin']

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

You wrote that your pricing structure allows only a minimal adjustment, and we take that seriously.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 4.61; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 4.66; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 4.63; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the earliest payment of the three, together with a firm volume commitment over the full contract term. If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

As you are the one handling this with us, we would be grateful if you would take Option A up with whoever decides on your side. Between two family companies, a clear and simple yes would be a good way to continue our cooperation.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
message.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We always value our business relationship and strive to provide you with the best service from our extensive product range.

We have reviewed your request with our management as suggested, but we are unable to offer further price reductions. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer stands at a price of €4.94 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this offer stays valid for 7 days.

You mentioned a firm volume commitment; please provide the exact volume figures you anticipate for this period. Which volume can you commit to? A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price.

We look forward to hearing from you soon.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
